_doc: The post-roll's sound (scripts/postroll_audio.py -> audio/postroll/postroll.wav), in seconds from the song's end, laid over S45-S48 (the human's notes, human interventions 2026-10-26): S45 dials the pledge line (DTMF, one tone per digit), one short ring (the US ringback, 440 + 480 Hz), then the muzak (the human's Suno cover, log/prompts/suno/muzak.md) fades in from just before its first chorus, which lands on the cut to S46 (hold music), and plays to the end, under the terms and the credits.

muzak.chorus_note: the cover's first chorus: the human's 'roughly 1:10'; located by matching the song's first-chorus chroma (60.6 s) against the cover, best at 72.7-73.4 s for tempo ratios 1.0-1.12; 72.82 s is the beat nearest the match
muzak.chorus_end_note: the end of the cover's first chorus (with its repeat): the human's 'roughly 1:50'; the song's chorus end (90-98.4 s) matches the cover at 103.1-103.6 s by chroma, so the chorus ends about 112 s; 112.71 s is the next beat
